extensionDescription.message: Expand any HTML5 video to fill the browser. Use custom controls, subtitles, and integrations with popular video services.

settingsSubtitle.message: Configure website exclusions, appearance, and theater mode keyboard shortcuts.

createdByHtml.message: Created by Tomasz Janusz

appearanceDescription.message: Choose where the picture sits, and the accent for controls, sliders, shortcuts, and highlights.

pictureAlignCenterDescription.message: Picture stays in the middle of the screen. Best for 16:9 screens.

pictureAlignTopDescription.message: Picture sits at the top, with a black band below for captions. Best for 16:10 and 4:3 screens.

pictureAlignSubtitlesOnlyDescription.message: Use Raised when subtitles are on and Centered when they are off.

featuresDescription.message: Turn optional theater mode behavior on or off.

volumeBoostDescription.message: Amplify volume up to 300% using Web Audio API. A brief loading spinner may appear the first time you enter theater mode while this is enabled.

richTheaterExperienceDescription.message: Enable richer integrations with your favorite video services, including YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Netflix, Bilibili, Bilibili.tv, Tencent Video / WeTV, Crunchyroll, and more. Theater Mode Everywhere can show additional information, support custom subtitle formats, and unlock service-specific features. Availability varies by service - read more

richTheaterExperiencePopupDescription.message: Enable richer integrations with your favorite video services. Availability varies by service.

youtubeIntegrationDescription.message: Enables support for captions, chapters, Most Replayed heatmap, and thumbnails on the timeline in theater mode.

vimeoIntegrationDescription.message: Enables support for chapter markers and thumbnails on the timeline in theater mode.

patreonIntegrationDescription.message: Enables support for captions and thumbnails on the timeline in theater mode.

twitchIntegrationDescription.message: Enables support for VOD chapters and thumbnails on the timeline in theater mode.

disneyIntegrationDescription.message: Enables support for captions and thumbnails on the timeline in theater mode when the player provides them.

netflixIntegrationDescription.message: Shows the current title and switches the player's subtitle languages in theater mode when the player has an active subtitle renderer. Chapters and timeline thumbnails are not supported.

bilibiliIntegrationDescription.message: Imports the video title, subtitles, chapters, the high-energy progress heatmap, and timeline thumbnails from bilibili.com when available. Some subtitles require signing in to Bilibili.

tencentIntegrationDescription.message: Imports episode titles, SRT/WebVTT subtitles and timeline thumbnails from Tencent Video / WeTV when available. Playback and next-episode controls use the player’s available controls.

websiteExclusionsDescription.message: Exclude websites where you do not want theater mode to activate automatically.

domainInputPlaceholder.message: e.g., youtube.com or paste a URL

exclusionsFooterTip.message: Tip: You can also manage exclusions directly by clicking the extension icon in your browser toolbar.

noExclusionsDescription.message: Theater mode will activate automatically on all video pages.

keyboardShortcutsDescription.message: Click any input field and press your desired key combination to configure. Modifiers like Ctrl, Alt, and Shift are supported.

cycleSwitchPlayerDescription.message: Works only when the page has more than one HTML5 video.

onlyOneVideoHud.message: Feature unavailable. Video switching is only possible when there are more players on the page.

cycleIframeHud.message: Switching works only with HTML5 video

privacyThingPopoverBody.message: Here is my new extension! With Privacy Thing, you decide what any website can see about you: location, language, time zone, and much more. It reduces how you can be tracked from site to site.

whatsNewLead.message: Meet Rich Theater Experience, with extra playback tools for supported video services.

whatsNewItemCaptions.message: Better captions: choose a track, customize how subtitles look, and keep your preferred language for each site.

whatsNewItemChapters.message: More context on the timeline: jump between chapters and see YouTube's Most Replayed moments.

whatsNewItemPreviews.message: Preview before you seek: hover over the timeline to see video thumbnails on supported YouTube, Vimeo, Patreon, Twitch, Disney+, Bilibili, Bilibili.tv, and Tencent Video / WeTV players.

whatsNewThanks.message: Enable Rich Theater Experience (Experimental) from the extension popup on supported sites, or from the Settings page. It's still experimental, so some features may vary by service :)

copyrightHtml.message: © 2026 Tomasz Janusz. All rights reserved.

keepControlsVisibleDescription.message: Keep the playback controls and progress bar visible in theater mode. The title and cursor still hide when idle.

nativeChatThemeYouTubeNative.message: YouTube chat follows the appearance selected in YouTube settings.

nativeChatFullscreenUnavailable.message: Fullscreen with chat is unavailable. Theater mode remains active.

shortcutExistingConflicts.message: Some shortcuts are assigned to multiple actions. Edit or reset the highlighted shortcuts to resolve the conflicts.

shortcutConflictDescription.message: $KEY$ is assigned to $OWNERS$. Move it to $TARGET$? The previous actions will no longer have this shortcut.

shortcutEscapeReserved.message: Escape is reserved for closing dialogs and exiting theater mode. Choose another shortcut for this action.

shortcutSaveErrorDescription.message: Your shortcuts were not changed. Please try again.

bilibiliIntlIntegrationDescription.message: Imports the title, subtitles, and timeline thumbnails from bilibili.tv episode and user-upload pages when available. Episode pages can show intro and outro markers. Next episode uses the player’s next control. This integration does not import a named chapter list or the high-energy heatmap.

crunchyrollIntegrationDescription.message: Shows the episode title, intro and credits, available subtitle controls, and timeline previews. Burned-in captions stay on the video and cannot be turned off.
